parameters.query: SELECT transaction_id, customer_id, amount, transaction_timestamp FROM transactions WHERE transaction_fingerprint = $1 LIMIT 1;

SELECT transaction_id, amount, currency, merchant_id, payment_method, country, transaction_timestamp, status, risk_score FROM transactions WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY transaction_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, transaction_id: $json.transaction_id, status: $json.final_status, risk: { score: $json.ai_risk_score, level: $json.ai_risk_level, confidence: $json.ai_confidence }, duplicate: $json.duplicate, decision: $json.decision, reason: $json.decision_reason, processed_at: $json.processed_at } }}
